data.scope: 1728 original training rows and 1152 already-reviewed Colab24 base answers. The latter never enter optimization and are no longer a reserved confirmation set.

training.loss: Mean code/EOS CE plus mean eligible logistic pair loss

plan.optimizer: Fresh AdamW once per replication; moments then persist through all six additional epochs. Original moments were not saved.
plan.snapshotTiming: Save at 144 and 432 additional steps; all six snapshots frozen before post-training assessments.
plan.selection: All three original rank-arm replications and all fixed snapshots; no best-checkpoint selection.
plan.scope: Exploratory fixed-capacity optimization-budget diagnostic on old training and already-seen Colab24 base answers. No fresh confirmation, specific ranking advantage, privileged access, native action or consciousness criterion.
